movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Both hands are used to support the body and execute the circular rotation.
movement_profile.footwork: Feet must remain off the ground; legs are held in a V-shape.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circular path parallel to the floor.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Torso rotates around the vertical axis of the body.
movement_profile.posture: Handstand position with the body inverted.

signature_moves.description: An advanced variation of the airflare.
signature_moves.name: Airflare 1.5

signature_moves.description: A variation performed on the elbows.
signature_moves.name: Elbow airflare

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Feet touching the ground during execution.

basic_steps: Rotate the torso around the vertical axis
Initiate circular travel parallel to the floor
Use both hands to support the circular motion
teaching.level_notes: Advanced: requires significant upper-body strength and technical control.
